ledger: toothbrush / comb | white toothbrush held in right hand at mouth | white toothbrush held in right hand at mouth | transforms into a black comb at 00:02 when raised to hair, then transforms back into a white toothbrush at 00:04 when lowered

findings.description: The white toothbrush held in the man's hand spontaneously transforms into a black comb as he moves his hand up to comb his hair, with no visible swap action.
The black comb spontaneously transforms back into a white toothbrush as his hand moves back down to his face.
